svg.aria-label: The Puls identity: its prompts and packs, its evals and judges
svg.title: The Puls identity: its prompts and packs, its evals and judges

g.text: its prompts and packs, its evals and judges
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: One class, and the rest is content:
Puls holds no tools. What it can do comes from the engine's toolsets and the packs it
names, and what proves it stays apart, so no host carries it.
